caption: The drawing depicts a detailed side profile of a carved eagle's head, rendered in muted natural tones. The head is predominantly a dull beige to light tan color, with carved feather details and visible grain lines suggesting a wooden texture. The beak is prominently hooked and colored a pale yellow with a slight reddish hue along the edge of the mouth. The eye is bold and black, set in a raised brow. There is a yellow, spiral decorative element emerging from the back of the head, curling in a circle. The object is isolated against a plain, off-white background, with no additional elements or objects in the composition.
title: Eagle
